arm_rule: three frozen arms in block-major order S0_sc_base / S1_bounded_search / S2_true_l1_diagnostic per block; S0 and S1 disclose the frozen base K1=319/K2=6492 and run 2 SC each (S1 adds rescore-only search over <=M=8 candidates, no extra SC, one final tag); S2 discloses K2 only and runs one oracle-conditioned L2 SC; 15 SC calls and 9 tags total; S2 carries ORACLE_TRUE_L1_CONTROL provenance, deployable=false, and is excluded from every operational aggregate; arms are constants, never CLI-tunable
claim_scope: descriptive single-factor bounded-search diagnostic on independent real development data (VAL split, N=32768, three DEV blocks); S2 is an oracle-labelled diagnostic control, never an operational protocol or deployable rate; not real-frame FER, reconciliation efficiency, leakage, key rate, scaling superiority, qualification or promotion evidence; the CE-normalized disclosure ratio is not qualification efficiency; undetected is never success
dev_block_rule: VAL development formation (P18 pattern, P20B ranges): sort VAL rows by (frame_id, pair_idx); require exactly 400 frames 1200..1599, 256 rows per frame, pair_idx 0..255 and symbols 0..1023; blocks 1200..1327 / 1328..1455 / 1456..1583 (128 frames = 32768 pairs each); frames 1584..1599 are the declared unused remainder; closed HOLD 1600..1983 never selected; no shuffle, resampling, overlap, padding, pooling or fitting
nll_rule: per block under the fixed floor-1e-15 TRAIN prior: l1_nll_bits = sum_i -log2 p1[high_i, bob_i]; l2_nll_bits = sum_i -log2 p2[high_i, bob_i, low_i]; total_nll_bits = l1 + l2 (bits per 32768-pair block); search selection uses the same tables (inf-tolerant argmin, greedy wins ties); tags and truth never enter selection
no_threshold_rule: there is no exact-count, FER, winner, monotonicity, superiority or qualification threshold and no recovery gate of any kind; found-count 0 and found-count >0 are both descriptive COMPLETE when integrity holds; only integrity/resource failures produce BLOCKED(<earliest gate>)
outcome_precedence: resource_abort: arm not executed (preregistered budget stop)
nonfinite: numeric nonfinite failure in L1/L2 SC; no tag
decode_failed: other L1/L2 SC exception; no tag
exact: tag pass and label == true label
undetected: tag pass and not exact (never success)
ratio_rule: disclosure_ce_ratio = design leakage / true block total NLL bits is a sample cross-entropy-normalized disclosure ratio and is explicitly NOT qualification reconciliation efficiency
search_rule: neighborhood P20B-NBHD-1: the greedy hard path plus single-symbol U-domain divergent alternates at undisclosed coordinates only (frozen/disclosed positions never varied); alternates ranked by ascending SC margin gap (best minus runner-up, ln units) with deterministic tie-break (layer L1 < L2, coordinate ascending); at most M-1 alternates rescored (M=8 total including greedy); each alternate re-encoded with the frozen polar_transform; rescore-only (no extra SC calls, L2 never re-decoded under L1 alternates); selection is argmin total NLL bits under the frozen floored p1/p2 (greedy wins ties); no tag and no truth enter selection; one final tag verifies the selected label after search
support_rule: f = counts / column totals; every cell below 1e-15 replaced by 1e-15; columns renormalized; p_b = column totals / total count; P1/P2 = accepted derive_p1/derive_p2(f) under A=32*U1+U2; no lambda, backoff, tuning, floor scan or fitting (exact P7 rule)
truth_boundary: Alice truth enters operational arms only through disclosed U values, tag construction and scoring (accepted run_operational_block boundary and sentinel, mirrored by run_search_block); S2 additionally conditions its L2 metric on the true high layer and is provenance-isolated
